release_notes: V14.44 build 248 adds a saved WebUI checkbox under Local buzzer sounds for controlling the physical buzzer master. Disabling it immediately silences the local buzzer without affecting visual alarms, WhatsApp alerts, glucose monitoring or alarm acknowledgement. Re-enabling allows an active alarm to resume unless it is snoozed. The WebUI and GPIO32 controls share the same authoritative alarmSoundEnabled state and NVS configuration. Existing physical controls, 30-minute chunked Nightscout recovery, shared 12-hour trend buffer, mini-trend recovery, dual-button forced backfill, factory reset, insulin and carbohydrate history, ketone history and OTA protections remain active.
